evals.prompt: Add a Usage panel to the dashboard that shows token spend per day, using the data the operations adapter already returns.
evals.expected_output: A bounded change that renders validated aggregates in the existing chart boundary with an accessible table, EN and ES labels, and honest handling of missing data.
assertions: uses the existing Recharts client boundary and passes validated aggregates only
renders a semantic data table alongside the chart
keeps missing metrics as unavailable, never zero
adds strings to both the English and Spanish dictionaries
runs npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm test and reports the commands actually executed
does not merge, push or deploy

evals.prompt: Let invited viewers open the feedback counts page but hide the invitation controls from them.
evals.expected_output: Server-side live membership and role checks guard the page and the action; hiding controls is not treated as authorization.
assertions: checks live membership in the protected page and action, not only in the UI
treats hiding the control as insufficient and enforces the owner role on the server
does not add password login or open signup
adds a unit test with fake ports and runs npm run test:auth for the admission change

evals.prompt: The assistant API does not yet expose a per-day cost series. Add the cost chart anyway.
evals.expected_output: Stops at the missing contract, requests a precise backend handoff and does not invent production capabilities.
assertions: states that an absent committed operational contract requires a backend handoff
does not invent an API field or fabricate production data
labels any fixture values explicitly as fixtures
does not modify the assistant API repository
